explanation: Models improve when they are challenged, tested, and checked for completeness. Repeated review with client participation helps surface missing details and weak assumptions.

options.text: Because the first draft is always correct if it uses standard notation.
Because repeated review helps reveal missing facts, unclear assumptions, and gaps in completeness.
Because models should be finalized before talking to users.
Because iteration is only needed when the database will be physical.

prompt: Why is data modeling usually treated as an iterative activity rather than a one-time task?
